_doc: Schedule formats for the Beam rebar pack (prompts/MODELLER_LOD_UPGRADE_PILL.md P8 SPEC). One entry per firm's table layout: how a schedule table is recognised (key_column + required headings), which heading is which field (columns, case-insensitive regexes), how bar text is read, and how a beam in the model finds its row (join). The building's own bars are never kept here: they come from its own drawing. status stays 'one building' until a second building passes.

formats.label: Beam schedule, Revit S-401 style
formats.source: observed on one private Revit-exported set (sheet S-401, 2 beam tables, 22 marks); not yet tested on a second building. Patterns copied from BIMCompiler scripts/lod/s401_marks.py COLS.

join.source: observed on the same set: Revit names like 'Beam - Concrete - Rectangular (M):GB1(300x600):<id>' (group 1 = the type mark); on the Hospital model it matches 0 of 1,970 IfcBeam (steel)
